findings.title: `task reverify` re-binds `handoff_ack` onto a commit no operator ever acknowledged, reopening the L025/fail-open direction `handoff_state` documents ("a HEAD that has moved past the ack reopens the pause"); the stated rationale — that clearing would strand a boundary "no idle-status verb can clear" — is contradicted by `handoff --ack` being legal from `testing`, exactly the status reverify lands the task in, so the safe alternative costs one operator command while the carry-forward silently certifies that the operator's new commits need no mechanical step (chmod, formula re-pin) and buys a guaranteed-FAIL verify that charges a rework round
